ITEM 1 | Roasted chicken leg piece (drumstick with attached thigh section), golden-brown to deep amber skin with darker caramelized patches, glossy and slightly oily surface, small granular crumbs or seasoning clinging to the skin, drumstick end pale and bare; overall roughly 11 cm long by 6 cm wide, upper portion about 3 cm thick, sitting at the top of the plate above the yellow grain | 150
ITEM 2 | Bright yellow couscous-like grain, fine granular texture, dry and fluffy with separate grains, scattered with small dark brown bits (possibly dried fruit pieces) and a few green flecks, mounded in an irregular pile about 9 cm by 7 cm and roughly 2 cm high, spilling loosely onto the plate | 130
ITEM 3 | Small compact cluster of yellow grain, slightly firmer and more molded, about 2.5 cm across and 1 cm high, sitting separately to the left of the main pile | 15
ITEM 4 | Scattered loose individual yellow grains and crumbs across the plate surface around the base of the chicken and grain pile, dry and matte | 5
